data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2020 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 844.32m. During 2020 gross claims outstanding increased to GBP 922.24m driven by increases in the provision for claims (gross change +GBP 94.845m) and exchange rate movements; COVID-19 produced measurable adverse claims impact (gross c.GBP 33.97m) particularly affecting Accident & Health and related specialty lines. The Syndicate also participated in an adverse development reinsurance arrangement covering losses incurred prior to 31 December 2019 (Syndicate participation 10%). No explicit standalone gross prior-year reserve movement figure for prior-year development (PYD) was uniquely presented in the notes, so a gross PYD figure could not be determined from the available disclosures.
raw_causal_phrases: increase in current year reserves and the impact of COVID-19.
claims deterioration on Accident and Health, mostly as a result of COVID-19
additional claims margin on FI and Management Liability
a loss ... reflecting an increase in current year reserves

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Balance Sheet (Liabilities) 'Claims outstanding' closing 2019 balance. The report does not present a discrete labelled 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure; only aggregate 'Change in claims outstanding' (gross) is shown which mixes current-year reserve increases and prior-year development. A gross claims development triangle is present but the extracted table in the source feed was partially garbled; therefore no reliable gross PYD was calculated from diagonal comparison. COVID-19 impact by class was available and used to populate LOB movements. Some LOB mappings (e.g. 'Other Specialty' -> 'Reinsurance - Specialty') involved interpretation and have reduced confidence.
